name: Words of the High Chief
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Winterfall are no longer a threat to me, but if you still want to find out what was driving the furbolg to create and consume this strange firewater, I think you should seek out Kelek Skykeeper.

He is part of a group known as the Emerald Circle, druids that are committed to their work in Felwood, healing the land from the corruption.

Kelek has much experience with the furbolgs in Felwood, and may be able to tell you more about the log.

Thank you, again, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Yes, if you let me examine this for a while, I might be able to translate it for you.

<Kelek flips through the pages.>

When I am able to look over this fully, I will send word to you.

Thank you for sharing this with me, adventurer. Very little is known about the Winterfall furbolg.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Emerald Circle is friendly to all, friend. What can I do for you?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 56 to 59, 33,000 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.objectiveText: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

quests.name: Mystery Goo
quests.objectiveText: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

quests.name: Toxic Horrors
quests.objectiveText: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

quests.name: Winterfall Runners
quests.objectiveText: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.
